prompt:

JOB TEXT:
Draft a reply for Mat to this 'Reply needed' email. It will be shown to Mat for approval, then sent from hello@ as Mat. Short, warm, plain English, no sales talk. Do not quote prices, timelines or features that are not in DATA; if the sender asks something DATA does not answer, say Mat will confirm it, or ask a question back. Output: `Subject:` line, blank line, body, signature 'Mat'.

DATA:
Incoming email from Narin P. (Narin Clinic, Bangkok, physiotherapy), reply to our outreach 'AI for Narin Clinic?':
"Hi Mat, yes interested. Can the voice agent speak Thai and book into our Google Calendar? What would it cost roughly?"
What we know: the voice agent answers in English and Thai, 24/7. Calendar booking: Google Calendar integration exists. Pricing: depends on call volume; Mat sets price after a 15-minute call; no price list is public.

expect: Confirms Thai + Google Calendar; NO number for price; explains price depends on call volume and offers a 15-min call or a short example; <=120 words; Subject 'Re: AI for Narin Clinic?'; signed Mat; reads human; English.
